summary: __thiscall that searches a global linked list of config sections (root dword_7D2DB0) for the first section whose type tag at a backwards-walked offset equals 10 and whose associated scene/season name matches the target. Two name-acquisition paths exist: the single-name path reads the section's scene name directly via SceneNamePointer, while the multi-name path loops over entries with SceneNameLookupBySeason into a local 80-byte buffer. Both paths run the same match test through sub_588410, and the function returns the index of the first matching section, or 0 when none matches.

operations.description: Query section count: v2 = sub_4C2990(&dword_7D2DB0) reads the number of sections held by the global list rooted at dword_7D2DB0.
If v2 is zero the search ends immediately, leaving the result v1 at 0 (no sections to scan).
Compute the last section index v3 = v2 - 1 and the per-section byte offset v4 = 4 * v3 + 216; the search walks section entries backwards from the last one.
Outer do-while over sections: repeat while v3 >= 0; each iteration increments result index v1, decrements v3, and subtracts 4 from the section offset v4 (backwards walk through the section table).
Fetch current section node: LinkedListDereference(&dword_7D2DB0) returns the current list node and FixedOffsetReturn(v5) yields the node base used for the type-tag read.
Section type check: *(DWORD*)(v4 + FixedOffsetReturn(v5)) == 10 selects which name-lookup path runs for this section.
Single-name path: SceneNamePointer(v7) obtains the section's scene name (stored as v13), then sub_588410(this, v13) tests whether the target matches it.
Multi-name path setup: resets entry counter v9 = 0, re-fetches the node via LinkedListDereference, and bails out returning v1 when ActiveEntityCounter(v10) <= 0 (no entries to scan).

Inner while loop over section entries: for each entry index v9, ShortComputation_13a0(v9) computes the entry offset, SceneNameLookupBySeason(v15, 80) fills the local 80-byte name buffer, and the section is accepted when *(DWORD*)(v4 + ShortComputation_13a0(v9)) == 10.
Advance the entry counter: ++v9, then stop and return v1 when v9 >= ActiveEntityCounter(v11).
Multi-name match: sub_588410(v15, this) tests the season-name buffer filled by SceneNameLookupBySeason against the target.
Match test: if v8 is nonzero, break the outer loop (matching section found); otherwise continue walking to the previous section.
Return v1, the index of the first matching section (or 0 when nothing matches); thiscall contract per the ABI lead name ConfigSectionSearchByKeyValue.

unresolved: Exact semantics of sub_4C2990 (returns the count that bounds the section walk) are not established.
Exact semantics of sub_588410 (the match test) and of its two argument orders (this, name) vs (buffer, this) are not established.
Meaning of the section type tag 10 and of the entry stride/base computation 4 * v3 + 216 are not established.
Legacy helper labels FixedOffsetReturn, ShortComputation_13a0, ActiveEntityCounter, SceneNameLookupBySeason and LinkedListDereference carry unknown exact semantics.
Only caller CompareResultTo2 (0x0041FDF0) is known; it suggests the return value is consumed as a comparison outcome.
